newsitem.title: USA: CEM Corp expects Q1 drop in earnings, revs.
newsitem.headline: CEM Corp expects Q1 drop in earnings, revs.

text.p: CEM Corp said Thursday it expects its first-quarter sales and earnings per share to fall below last year's results for that period.
It attributed the decline to sluggish sales of its systems for governmental and environmental uses.
The company said it expects to report net sales of about $6.6 million in the quarter ended September 30 compared with $7.5 million in same period last year.
It expects to post net income below last year's levels of $677,000, or $0.18 per share. CEM did not specify how much of a drop in net earnings it anticipated.
CEM manufactures microwave-based instrumentation for testing, analysis and process control
